args.subject: Marrow Agrisupply handover
args.body:
Hi Tobias,

Handover note for Marrow Agrisupply. Items from the 9 June thread in #central-team and Moss's Central handoffs digest (2 Jan 2026):

- Eastbank door-label mismatch (ticket PD-4821): the receiving-door import attached to the ticket labels doors E1/E2, but the store's booking sheet uses 01/02. It needs sorting before anyone reimports, or we'll create duplicate doors. Hollis was owner on setup/support.

- Pine Crossing missing afternoon shift: the morning receiver said the appointment screen only shows the afternoon shift. A driver arrived at 7:10 the day before and the receiver wrote his trailer number on a sticky note. This is a setup gap, not a training issue. Hollis was to check the shift template and ask support to reproduce it with the store login. No ticket number was recorded for this one.

- Pallet-jack icon feature request (FR-882): Marrow Agrisupply asked for custom pallet-jack icons on the Pemberline Dock yard map for their seasonal fertilizer sheds. Support routed it to the product backlog for Q2 review (per the 2 Jan digest).

Note: I found nothing newer than 9 June on the first two items, and nothing newer than the 2 Jan digest on FR-882, so please check current status on all three before relying on this.

Thanks,
Hollis
